description: No incident response plan for security incidents affecting the CDE.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 12.10 - Suspected and confirmed security incidents that could impact the cardholder data environment are responded to immediately
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Verify existence of documented incident response plan covering detection, containment, analysis, recovery, and post-incident activities. Monitor for annual plan reviews, testing exercises, incident response team training, and 24/7 incident response availability. Check for incident logging and evidence retention procedures.

sources.title: PCI DSS v4.0
sources.section: Requirement 12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies
